text: PRODUCT SPECIFICATION SHEET — Salad Dressing Vinaigrette
Supplier: Nortena Distribucion Alimentaria S.L. | Batch/Lot no.: L2026320-285
Ingredients: sulphur dioxide (preservative E220), ginger powder, spelt flour, coriander seed, yeast extract, lemon zest, roasted peanuts, citric acid, paprika, brown sugar, lactose.
Contains: Milk (including lactose), Cereals containing gluten, Sulphur dioxide and sulphites (>10mg/kg), Peanuts.
Storage conditions: Store frozen at -18C or below
\* Manufactured in a facility that also processes Soybeans. May contain traces of Soybeans.
